title: United States Workers Protection Act of 2004
short_title: United States Workers Protection Act of 2004

committees.name: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee

actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Governmental Affairs.

latest_action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Governmental Affairs.

summaries.text: United States Workers Protection Act of 2004 - Amends the Office of Federal Procurement Policy Act to prohibit: (1) outsourced Federal Government work from being performed by a contractor outside the United States unless Federal employees previously performed such work outside the United States (currently, prohibited by the Transportation, Treasury, and Independent Agencies Appropriations Act, 2004); (2) work on a procurement contract from being performed outside the United States unless it is necessary in order to meet a requirement for goods and services outside the United States or the President deems it necessary for national security reasons; and (3) Federal funds from being disbursed to a State until the Governor of the State has transmitted written certification that none of the funds will be spent on work performed outside the United States. Provides that this Act becomes effective for States two fiscal years after enactment.
